scope.description: Conservative, read-only routing catalogue for ShramSetu. A match is guidance, not a legal eligibility decision or proof that a complaint will be accepted.

government_routes.name: SAMADHAN Portal — Ministry of Labour & Employment
government_routes.jurisdiction: India; the competent authority and applicable law depend on the claim and jurisdiction selected in the portal.
government_routes.limitations: SAMADHAN handles specified labour claims and industrial disputes. Do not assume every private-employer complaint is within the portal's jurisdiction. The worker must check the applicable claim type, state/district and competent authority. Filing is completed by the worker; ShramSetu does not submit it.

government_routes.name: Telangana Labour Department
government_routes.limitations: This is a state department information/contact route, not a promise that an online complaint form exists for the worker's exact issue. The appropriate office and process must be confirmed.

government_routes.name: Directorate of Factories, Telangana
government_routes.jurisdiction: Telangana; only establishments covered by the applicable factories legislation.
government_routes.limitations: Only potentially relevant where the workplace is legally within the Directorate's jurisdiction. A construction site or other workplace should not be classified as a factory without evidence.

government_routes.name: Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
government_routes.jurisdiction: Telangana; scheme and benefit eligibility conditions apply.
government_routes.limitations: This route concerns construction-worker registration and welfare benefits. Registration, work history and scheme-specific conditions must be checked. It is not a general wage-claim portal.

government_routes.name: Telangana Police / Emergency Response Support System
government_routes.limitations: Recommend police/emergency assistance only where the worker's description indicates a possible offence, immediate threat or urgent safety concern. Do not delay urgent help for more information.

government_routes.name: Telangana Police Women Safety Wing
government_routes.jurisdiction: Telangana; service scope depends on the incident and affected person.
government_routes.limitations: Specialised support route. Confirm the correct intake channel for the specific issue; do not represent this unit as the direct complaint authority for every workplace sexual-harassment complaint.

government_routes.name: District Legal Services Authority / Telangana State Legal Services Authority
government_routes.jurisdiction: District/state legal-services system in Telangana; free legal aid eligibility is assessed under applicable law.
government_routes.limitations: This is a legal-aid information route, not a guarantee of representation. Eligibility and the appropriate district authority must be checked.

government_routes.name: Telangana Prajavani
government_routes.jurisdiction: Telangana government departments and public services.
government_routes.limitations: Use only when the grievance concerns a Telangana government department, public service or administrative action. Do not recommend for an ordinary private-employer wage dispute.

government_routes.name: CPGRAMS — Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System
government_routes.jurisdiction: Central government ministries/departments and participating public authorities.
government_routes.limitations: Use for grievances against a central government ministry/department or public authority, not as a generic private-employer labour complaint channel. The Ministry of Labour states that email grievances are not entertained through CPGRAMS; use the portal.

government_routes.name: e-Shram Grievance Management System
government_routes.jurisdiction: India; limited to e-Shram registration, account, card or related service issues.
government_routes.limitations: This is for e-Shram service issues, not a general complaint route for unpaid wages, unsafe work or contractor abuse.

government_routes.name: EPFO Grievance Management System (EPFiGMS)
government_routes.jurisdiction: EPFO-covered provident-fund accounts, establishments and services.
government_routes.limitations: Use only for provident-fund account, contribution or EPFO service problems. Membership/establishment details may be required.

ngo_leads.name: AASHRAY
ngo_leads.limitations: Potential lead only. Current services, individual case intake, contact details and email referral acceptance are unverified.

ngo_leads.name: Montfort Social Institute
ngo_leads.limitations: Potential lead only. Current services, individual case intake, contact details and email referral acceptance are unverified.

ngo_leads.name: Association for Promoting Social Action (APSA)
ngo_leads.limitations: Potential lead only. Current services, individual case intake, contact details and email referral acceptance are unverified.

ngo_leads.name: Don Bosco for Migrants
ngo_leads.limitations: Potential regional lead only. Current operating contact, service coverage, individual case intake and email referral acceptance are unverified.

ngo_leads.name: Human Rights Law Network (HRLN)
ngo_leads.limitations: Potential legal-support lead only. Local case intake, representation, contact details and email referral acceptance are unverified.

ngo_leads.name: Migrant Resource Centre Hyderabad
ngo_leads.limitations: Potential lead only. Operating organisation, current services, contact details and email referral acceptance are unverified.
